name: Restricted Formal Review Phase Declaration
purpose: Freeze admissible external-review terminology and establish RFPR boundaries before theorem packaging.

phase_definition.canonical_statement: The restricted formal peer-review preparation phase permits the normalization and packaging of local theorem candidates for external-style scrutiny without permitting global escalation.
phase_definition.non_escalation_rule: Theorem packaging does not imply proof finality, physical derivation, or ontology closure.

governance_rules.rule: Every theorem package must explicitly state: 'Left-only and right-only interpretations are locally valid but incomplete without ⇔R inseparability.'
Proof presentations must maintain active visibility of failure boundaries and counterexamples.
No package may silently strengthen assumptions beyond the FSUB substrate.
